notes.note_text: MDT outcome recorded. Case accepted for onward management at Queen Elizabeth Hospital King's Lynn. Recommendation is to proceed to specialist clinic review and implement the agreed pathway.
Patient discussed at Upper GI MDT. Imaging reviewed and appearances remain suspicious for malignancy. Recommend correlation with histology and proceed with next staging step.
Consultant opinion at MDT favours treatment escalation given current disease burden. Surgical and oncological options were both reviewed with a preference for multidisciplinary follow-up.
